movelist.name: Acid Spray
movelist.effect: Acid Spray lowers the target’s Special Defense 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Toxic
movelist.effect: The target is Badly Poisoned. If the user is Poison Type, Toxic cannot miss.

movelist.name: Slash
movelist.effect: Slash is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Feint
movelist.effect: If a foe uses a Move with the Shield Keyword in response to one of your actions, you may activate Feint to cause the triggering Move to Fail. Feint is activated as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Smokescreen
movelist.effect: Smokescreen creates a blast of Smoke that covers the target area; the Smoke persists until the end of the encounter, or until Defog or Whirlwind are used. All targets attacking from or into the Smoke receive a -3 penalty to Accuracy.

abilities.name: Stench
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s Moves Flinch Targets on a roll of 18+. If a move already has a chance of Flinching foes, the Effect Range is increased by +3 instead. Whenever the user Flinches a foe with an attack, that foe gains a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for 1 full round.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.effect: The user’s Accuracy cannot be lowered, their attacks cannot have Accuracy Penalties (such as from Illuminate), the user is immune to the Blind condition (but not Total Blindness), and the user ignores any Evasion not directly derived from Stats (such as from the Instinct Ability, or from moves like Minimize).

abilities.name: Aftermath
abilities.effect: The user creates a Burst 1. Everything in the Burst loses three Ticks of Hit Points.
